title: MORNING PRAYER SPEAK INTO THE NEW WEEK BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES
text: Lift your hands wherever you are. This is not an ordinary morning. This is not an ordinary week. You are not stepping into seven days casually. You are stepping in prophetically, intentionally, and with dominion. I hear the spirit of the Lord saying, if you do not speak into the weak, something else will. Somebody shout, I speak into my weak. This morning prayer is warfare, alignment, and prophetic takeover of your entire week. Psalm 118:24, this is the day the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it. Meaning, the day does not decide your mood. You decide the day's outcome. Your week is not shaped by events. It's shaped by your words. Whoever speaks first controls the spiritual climate. Say this week I will not be silent. >> This is why witches speak into the morning. This is why divine decree at dawn. This is why evil altars chant before sunrise because the morning is spiritual territory. But today you are speaking before the enemy moves. Lift your voice. I take authority over this week. I decree the sun will favor you. The moon will favor you. The wind will favor you. The elements will cooperate with you. Time will obey you. Days will align with your destiny. Nights will shield you. Psalm 121:6. The sun shall not strike you by day, nor the moon by night. Your weak is commanded. Hear me. The enemy also plans demonic distractions, unexpected problems, sudden attacks, disappointment, emotional warfare, confusion, delay, setbacks, rising fear, dream attacks, financial attacks, missed opportunities. But not this week. Shout every evil agenda cancelled. I decree no accident, no tragedy, no sickness, no disappointment, no sudden disaster, no emotional attack, no spiritual attack, no financial sabotage. The enemy's plans collapse. Proverbs 3:6, in all your ways acknowledge him and he shall direct your paths. Say, Lord, align my weak. >> Align. I decree your steps are ordered. Your thoughts are aligned. Your decisions are correct. Your meetings are divinely arranged. Your interactions are spirit-led. Your schedule is sanctified. Your movement is protected. Your choices are guided. Nothing happens by accident this week. Breakthrough is not random. Breakthrough is commanded. Say, I open the doors of my weak. >> I decree doors of favor open doors of opportunity, open doors of visibility, open doors of connection, open doors of resources, open doors of good news, open. Isaiah 22:22, he opens and no one shuts. Your weak will respond to grace. Lift your hands. I see angels moving like morning wind. The Lord says, "Assign my angels into your week." Say, "Angels of God, go ahead of me." I decree angels prepare your path. Angels protect your household. Angels secure your appointments. Angels block danger. Angels open doors. Angels influence hearts. Angels bring opportunities. Your weak is spiritually escorted. Begin to pray. brandtori. Let every second of this week yield to your prophetic command. Someone, you have a meeting [clears throat] this week that determines your next level. God says, "I will give you favor." Someone named Oluchi, good news is coming this week. Someone named Ben, I see financial release. A woman, your heart was heavy last night. This week will bring clarity. Someone in the UK, a job related breakthrough is close. Someone, you are receiving a call of divine opportunity this week. Say this with authority. My week is blessed. My path is straight. My steps are guided. My day is fruitful. My night is peaceful. My mind is sharp. My spirit is alert. My hands are productive. My helpers locate me. My enemies fail. My destiny advances. My family is preserved. Now shout, "This week obeys me." >> Place your hand on your head. I decree you will not fail this week. You will not fall this week. You will not cry this week. You will not struggle this week. You will not be confused this week. You will not be attacked this week. You will rise. You will shine. You will prosper. You will advance. You will testify. You will celebrate. This week bows to your voice. This week aligns with God's word. This week responds to your prophecy. So shall it be. >> Lift your hands. A mighty prophetic wind is rising. The spirit realm is listening. This is not a casual prayer. This is a weekly takeover decree. I hear the Lord saying, "Do not enter the weak quietly. Speak loudly." Somebody shout, "I take charge of my weak." >> This is the moment where atmospheres bow and unseen forces scatter. Hear me. Before you even woke up, someone somewhere may have spoken. Jealousy, curses, negative expectations, evil projections, manipulation, monitoring spirits, delay affirmations, fear, resentment, evil wishes. But Isaiah 54:17 says, "Every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn." Say, "Every evil word against my weak be canled." >> I decree words spoken in secret nullified. Words spoken from jealousy erased. Words spoken in anger broken. Words spoken from witchcraft reversed. Words spoken against your family silenced. Your weak is protected from evil utterances. The enemy always tries to strike early. Early sickness, early disappointment, early discouragement, early confusion, early spiritual laziness, early emotional heaviness, early dream attacks, early anxiety, early setbacks. But hear the prophecy. This week, the enemy will not strike first. Say, Satan, you will not move before me. I decree your week will not begin with trouble. Your week will not open with fear. Your week will not start with attack. Your week will not start with confusion. Your week will not begin in darkness. You will move before the enemy this week. Stretch your hands forward. You will now speak into each day before the enemy plans anything. Say Monday, align with God's purpose. Tuesday, bring favor and light. Wednesday, reveal my opportunities. Thursday, deliver 100 my breakthrough. Friday, crown my efforts with success. Saturday, restore my strength and joy. Sunday, prepare me for a new glory realm. Every day is spoken for. Nothing remains for the enemy to manipulate. Lift your hands. I see angels moving like flashes of light into your weak. The Lord says, "Assign them before the enemy positions his own agents." Say, "Angels of God, go ahead of this week." I decree angels clear your path. Angels block every trap. Angels remove every obstacle. Angels frustrate evil intentions. Angels influence the right people. Angels stand guard at your workplace. Angels surround your family day and night. Your weak becomes angelically fortified. Some of you didn't experience breakthrough because of wrong timing. But Ecclesiastes 3:1 says to everything there is a season. Say, Lord, align my timing. This week I decree you will not be late. You will not be too early. You will not miss timing. You will not miss opportunities. You will not arrive after the blessing. You will not be absent when your name is called. Your divine schedule is aligned. This week is covered. Say no evil shall befall me. I decree no accidents, no injuries, no hospital visits, no emergencies, no sudden bad news, no unseen dangers, no traps, no demonic ambushes. Your going out and coming in are preserved. Pray. Shandere, your destiny takes the lead this week. Someone this week brings the answer you've prayed for since last month. Someone named blessing, your week is crowned with favor. Someone named Tundday, a work situation will turn around for your good. A woman you feared this week, God says, "Fear not. I've gone ahead of you." Someone in Canada, your promotion will be discussed. Someone, a delay from last week, will suddenly break this week. Declare, "My week is under divine authority. My week is sealed in God's presence. My weak is filled with open doors. My weak is blessed with favor. My weak is shielded from evil. My weak is fruitful and productive. My weak responds to my prophecy. My weak cannot be manipulated. My weak will produce testimonies. Now shout, "This week, I will see the hand of God." >> Place your hand on your head. I decree your spirit is sharpened. Your steps are ordered. Your path is cleared. Your empowerment is sanctified. Your helpers are activated. Your opportunities are released. Your protection is secured. Your victory is guaranteed. You step into this week with boldness. You walk in power. You advance with authority. You move with angelic backing. The enemy will not speak before you. The enemy will not act before you. The enemy will not rise before you. You take the lead, so shall it be. Lift your hands. Close your eyes. Breathe in the presence of God. I hear the spirit of the Lord saying, "This week will not happen to you. It will happen for you." Somebody shout, "My week will work for me." This is the wave where you shift timelines. You rewrite outcomes. You redirect patterns. You silence darkness. You command the weak with authority. You are not entering this week as a participant. You are entering as a governing spirit. Job 22 28. You shall decree a thing and it shall be established for you. Meaning you speak, the weak obeys. You declare, the atmosphere rearranges. YOU COMMAND, heaven enforces. You release words, angels move. Say, "This week, every word I speak shall manifest. I decree your words become laws in the spirit. Your decrees become spiritual legislation. Your voice becomes prophetic authority. This week will not ignore your prayer. Some weeks fail not because of demons but because of disalignment. You were in the right week but the wrong moment. But hear the Lord, I synchronize your life with my timing. Say, Lord, align my week with your perfect timing. I decree no more wrong timing, no more missed moments, no more arriving late, no more being overlooked, no more near success failure. Your life enters divine rhythm. Distraction is a spirit. It looks small but it destroys destinies. Wasted conversations, unnecessary emotions, draining people, unfocused mind, scattered attention, sudden discouragement, mental heaviness, spiritual laziness, wrong calls, unexpected drama. But this week, nothing will pull you off course. Say, spirit of distraction, leave my week. I decree your focus sharpens. Your mind aligns. Your attention strengthens. Your purpose stabilizes. Your spirit becomes alert. No distraction will hijack your destiny. This week there are breakthrough windows God opens at specific times and many miss them unknowingly. But this week I hear your moment will not pass. You say I step into my breakthrough moments. This week I decree a window of favor appears for you. A window of opportunity appears. A window of financial increase appears. A window of connection appears. A window of restoration appears. A window of divine approval appears. You will recognize it. You will step into it. You will maximize it. Some of your biggest breakthroughs are hidden in ordinary moments. that text message, that email, that conversation, that idea, that prompting, that person, that instruction, that dream. Say, "Holy Spirit, sharpen my discernment this week. I decree you will hear clearly. You will see accurately. You will sense deeply. You will know instantly. You will perceive spiritually. You will not miss signals. Your spirit will vibrate when destiny is near. Pray in the spirit. These tongues are perfecting your week. Someone you have been confused since last week. Clarity comes in the next 48 hours. Someone named Kiche, God is granting you direction this week. Someone named Michael, a surprising email is coming. A woman, you cried before sleeping last night. God says joy is coming this week. Someone in the US, [singing and music] your paperwork will move faster this week. Someone, a divine helper will remember you. Declare boldly. My week is blessed and secured. My steps are aligned. My atmosphere is controlled. My spirit is sensitive. My purpose [music and singing] is clear. My destiny is moving. My hands will prosper. My mind will not fail. My health is preserved. My family is protected. My voice carries authority. Say, I take prophetic control of my weak. Place your hand on your head. I decree your spirit is lifted. Your faith is activated. Your discernment is sharpened. Your destiny is aligned. Your path is illuminated. Your opportunities are unlocked. Your breakthroughs are released. Your angels are deployed. [singing and music] Your results are guaranteed. You will not struggle this week. You will not fail this week. You will not be delayed this week. You will not be confused this week. You will walk in power. You will walk in peace. You will walk in clarity. You will walk in victory. This week belongs to you. This week answers to you. This week yields to grace. So shall it be. Something is breaking open above you. [music] The cloud of your weak is shifting. I hear the spirit of the Lord saying, "Your heavens are open. Walk under it." Somebody shout, "My heavens are open." >> My heavens are open. >> Open heavens mean you won't struggle for results. Favor flows easily. Answers come quickly. Doors open without force. Opportunities appear without stress. Breakthroughs locate you. Help us find you. God moves ahead of you. This is that week. Isaiah 60:1. Arise, shine, for your light has come. Morning glory means you shine before others. Rise. You are preferred without explanation. You are lifted without competition. You rise early in the week. Good things begin early. Blessings start showing immediately. Say, I receive the morning glory mantle. I decree your week opens in glory. Your day starts with favor. Your path shines with light. Your decisions carry wisdom. Your environment responds to grace. You will not begin this week small. Favor is not luck. It is divine endorsement. Psalm 5:12. For you, oh Lord, will bless the righteous. You will surround him with favor as with a shield. Say, "Favor, surround my weak." >> I decree where others are ignored, you will be remembered. Where others are rejected, you'll be accepted. Where others struggle, you will succeed easily. Where others lack, you will overflow. Where others wait, you will be accelerated. Your name will ring in the right places. Your presence will carry influence. Your voice will carry weight. Your hands will produce results. This week, favor follows you. I see angels moving with speed, [music] carrying scrolls labeled testimony, approval, access, good news. The Lord says, I release angels of acceleration into your week. Say, angels of speed, go ahead of me. Go ahead. I decree speed in opportunities, speed in approvals, speed in financial transactions, speed in family breakthroughs, speed in business progress, speed in divine connections. Where time was slow, God gives you supernatural acceleration. Revelation 3 8. See, I have set before you an open door. Not a door you must break down. Not a door you must fight for. A door that is already open. Say, "Open doors manifest in my weak." I decree open doors in your workplace. Open doors in your finances. Open doors in business. Open doors in relationships. Open doors for divine connections. Open doors for ministry. Open doors for visibility. Nothing will block what God has opened. The enemy opens doors too. Door of discouragement, door of confusion, door of unnecessary battles, door of delay, door of distraction, door of temptation, door of sudden attacks, door of emotional heaviness. Say, every evil door be shut. I decree doors of attack shut. Doors of disappointment shut. Doors of sorrow shut. Doors of CONFUSION SHUT. DOORS OF FEAR SHUT. DOORS OF ANXIETY SHUT. DOORS OF SPIRITUAL weakness shut. Your week is guarded. Every week carries a blessing package as signed from heaven. Say, Lord, release my weekly blessing. I decree blessings in the morning, blessings in the afternoon, blessings in the evening, blessings in your going out, blessings in your coming in, blessings in your thoughts, blessings in your decisions, blessings in your conversations, blessings in your assignments, blessings in your finances, blessing will overshadow every day of this week. Pray. Let your spiritual climate shift now. Someone, you will receive an unexpected message of favor within 72 hours. Someone named Queen, God is ordering your steps this week. Someone named Joseph, a financial door is opening. A woman, your week was supposed to start with trouble. God has reversed it. Someone in the UK, your documents will move forward. Someone, the phone call you have been waiting for is coming. Declare with power, my heavens are open. My week is blessed. My path shines brighter. My steps are accelerated. My helpers are activated. My doors will open. My favor is undeniable. My opportunities are visible. My results will speak. My angels are working. My victory is certain. Say, "This week, open heavens follow me." Place your hand upon your chest. I decree the glory of God surrounds your weak. The favor of God goes before you. The strength of God carries you. The wisdom of God guides you. The angels of God accompany you. The speed of God accelerates you. The peace of God covers you. The goodness of God follows you. Your week is blessed beyond measure. Your path is favored beyond competition. Your doors are open beyond limitation. A prophetic wind of increase is blowing. I hear the spirit of God this week. Little will become much and much will become overflow. Somebody shout, I receive my harvest this week. >> I receive my harvest. >> This wave pulls blessings out of hiding and multiplies every seed of effort you sow. Isaiah 65:23. They shall not labor in vain. Meaning your work will produce results. Your efforts will be rewarded. Your labor will not be wasted. Your ideas will not die unborn. Your opportunities will not scatter. Your prayers will not fall to the ground. Say, "My harvest will not be delayed." >> I decree every good thing you planted grows. Every opportunity you pursued manifest. Every step you've taken produces fruit. Every prayer you've prayed returns with answers. Every seed you've sown yields harvest. This week will give you results. The enemy loves to attack at the edge of manifestation. Someone promising to help but suddenly withdrawing. Opportunities collapsing last minute. Breakthroughs that come but don't last. Good news turning into silence. Almost victories. Just missed it moments. Doors opening but closing too fast. Not this week. Shout no more near breakthrough failure. I decree you will not come close and lose it. You will not almost enter and be pushed [music] out. You will not almost succeed and fail last minute. You will not almost receive and watch it disappear. This week the breakthrough will fully happen. John 6 11 he took the loaves and they multiplied. Multiplication is not arithmetic. It is supernatural increase. Say, Lord, multiply my blessings this week. >> I decree your ideas multiply, your clients multiply, your sales multiply, your influence multiplies, your strength multiplies, your results multiply, your helpers multiply, your opportunities multiply, your testimony multiplies. This week [music] will exceed expectations. Sometimes the greatest blessing is the right person. Psalm 121:2, my help comes from the Lord. Say, my helpers will find me this week. I decree helpers who speak for you appear. Helpers who lift you appear. Helpers who favor you appear. Helpers who recommend you appear. Helpers who open doors appear. Helpers who support your destiny appear. Where you cannot [singing] enter, your helpers will enter for you. Devourers steal time, money, energy, opportunities, peace, [music] ideas, resources, relationships. But Malachi 3:11 says, "I will rebuke the devourer for your sake." Say, "Every devourer assigned to my weak be rebuked." I decree your money is secure. Your relationships are secure. Your opportunities are secure. Your ideas are secure. Your open doors are secure. Your health is secure. Your peace is secure. Nothing will drain you this week. Pray. your week is shifting into overflow. Someone, God is turning a no from last week into a yes this week. Someone named Daniel, a financial breakthrough is coming. Someone named Miriam. Your week will bring unexpected favor. A woman you feared receiving bad news this week. The Lord says good news. Instead, someone in the US, a door for relocation is opening. Someone, your harvest will surprise you this week. Say this with fire. My harvest is released. My blessings are multiplied. My helpers are activated. My breakthrough will not fail. My opportunities will manifest. My results will increase. My labors will not be wasted. My prayers will bear fruit. My steps will produce testimony. My week will overflow. My voice carries authority. My destiny advances daily. Declare, "This week, I step into my harvest realm." Place your hand on your head. I decree your harvest is secure. Your increase is guaranteed. Your multiplication is activated. Your helpers are positioned. Your breakthrough is completed. Your blessing is protected. Your steps are directed. Your day is favored. Your week is blessed. From Monday to Sunday, you will see the fingerprints of God. Your results will speak. Your testimonies will manifest. Your joy will overflow. This week will not end empty. It will end in abundance. So shall it be.
